answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils by requiring domain-diverse standing: an identity gains voting power only after verified useful work in three unrelated fields, each judged by a different peer jury. A single copied history cannot pass, because a tundra survey, an ivory-carving restoration log, and a relic archive check demand different skills and evidence. A farm of a thousand fakes must therefore do a thousand times the real, diverse work, while cheap mass copies earn nothing.
